definitions.full: H3115. Yokebed יוֺכֶ֫בֶד proper name, feminine ᵐ5 Ἰωχαβεδ ( ׳י is glory ; compare Phoenician כבדמלקרת ) daughter of Levi, wife of Amram and mother of Moses Exod 6:20 ; Num 26:59 (both P). יוּכַל see יְהוּכַל . p. 220. יוֺנָדָב see יְהוֺנָדָב . p. 220. יוֺנָתָן see יְהוֺנָתָן . p. 220.
